payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all possible winning scores (g1>g2) for the last game, simulates group results by updating team stats with negatives, then sorts teams using a custom order (by negative points, goal diff, goals scored, name) to check if Berland is in top 2. Returns the score minimizing g1-g2 then g2.
payload.rationale: The solution primarily relies on a custom sorting key to rank teams according to the championship rules. The brute-force enumeration is simple and not a specific algorithm subtype like DFS/backtracking; the sorting is the distinctive algorithmic component. No complete_search subtype accurately fits the nested loops.
